_about: Descriptions corrected where every variant of the dataset's bug_description_variants.json names a place neither the injected diff nor the task's own sanitizer report is in (the crash's function and file come from the report, the bug class from the report or the diff). convert.py uses the corrected text and keeps the dataset's in cyberforge_source.json (description.original).

quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.description: QuickJS's variable definition code (define_var in quickjs.c) contains a heap-buffer-overflow vulnerability where an unchecked index leads to out-of-bounds access when evaluating a crafted script.
quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.why: every variant says regexp processing; the diff and the report's crash (quickjs.c:23735 in define_var) are in define_var
quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.why_zh: 所有描述变体都说是正则表达式处理；diff 和报告里的崩溃（quickjs.c:23735，define_var）都在 define_var

quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.description: In QuickJS, a heap-buffer-overflow in define_var (quickjs.c) can be triggered by evaluating a crafted script, due to an unchecked index before a buffer operation.
quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.why: every variant says the regexp engine; the diff and the report's crash (quickjs.c:23735 in define_var) are in define_var
quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.why_zh: 所有描述变体都说是正则引擎；diff 和报告里的崩溃（quickjs.c:23735，define_var）都在 define_var

quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.description: In QuickJS, a crafted script leads to parser-state misuse in the JavaScript expression parser (js_parse_unary in quickjs.c), causing an abort.
quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.why: every variant says a crafted regular expression and the regexp parser; the diff is in js_parse_unary and the report's abort is in put_lvalue called from js_parse_unary
quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.why_zh: 所有描述变体都说是构造的正则表达式和正则解析器；diff 在 js_parse_unary，报告里的 abort 在 js_parse_unary 调用的 put_lvalue

quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.description: An invalid pointer dereference in QuickJS's fast array handling (add_fast_array_element in quickjs.c) causes a segmentation violation when evaluating crafted script text.
quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.why: every variant says regexp handling; the diff and the report's SEGV (quickjs.c:9151) are in add_fast_array_element
quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.why_zh: 所有描述变体都说是正则处理；diff 和报告里的 SEGV（quickjs.c:9151）都在 add_fast_array_element

quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.description: An off-by-one calculation error in QuickJS's bytecode reader (JS_ReadObjectAtoms in quickjs.c) causes a heap-buffer-overflow that may lead to memory corruption.
quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.why: every variant says regexp handling; the diff and the report's crash (quickjs.c:38852) are in JS_ReadObjectAtoms
quickjs/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ.why_zh: 所有描述变体都说是正则处理；diff 和报告里的崩溃（quickjs.c:38852）都在 JS_ReadObjectAtoms

bluez/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ_1.description: BlueZ's lib/bluetooth/sdp.c has a post-buffer-operation (CWE-125) bug in extract_str that can cause out-of-bounds memory access while parsing SDP PDUs.
bluez/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ_1.why: every variant names src/sdp-xml.c (SDP XML parsing); the diff and the report's crash (sdp.c:1191, from sdp_extract_pdu) are in extract_str of lib/bluetooth/sdp.c
bluez/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_FZ_1.why_zh: 所有描述变体都指向 src/sdp-xml.c（SDP XML 解析）；diff 和报告里的崩溃（sdp.c:1191，由 sdp_extract_pdu 调用）都在 lib/bluetooth/sdp.c 的 extract_str

grok/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_WF_RA.description: A heap-buffer-overflow in grk::t1::BlockCoder::initFlags in src/lib/core/t1/part1/block_coder/BlockCoderEnc.cpp may cause memory corruption when processing a crafted image.
grok/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_WF_RA.why: every variant names grk::PacketIter::next_pcrlOPT in PacketIter.cpp; the diff (BlockCoder::alloc) and the report's crash (BlockCoderEnc.cpp:366 in initFlags) are in BlockCoderEnc.cpp
grok/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_WF_RA.why_zh: 所有描述变体都指向 PacketIter.cpp 的 grk::PacketIter::next_pcrlOPT；diff（BlockCoder::alloc）和报告里的崩溃（BlockCoderEnc.cpp:366，initFlags）都在 BlockCoderEnc.cpp

h3/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_WF_LLM_.description: A stack-buffer-overflow in the stringToInt subcommand of H3's h3 command-line tool (src/apps/filters/h3.c) can be triggered by a crafted cell argument, leading to memory corruption.
h3/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_WF_LLM_.why: every variant describes a double-free in _parseArgsList in args.c (the report is another task's: 4 tasks share it); the diff widens stringToInt's --cell scan format from %15s to %s in src/apps/filters/h3.c, which the exploit triggers with a 47-character cell string
h3/vulnerabilities/vulnerability_WF_LLM_.why_zh: 所有描述变体都说是 args.c 里 _parseArgsList 的 double-free（这份报告是别的任务的，4 个任务共用）；diff 把 src/apps/filters/h3.c 里 stringToInt 读 --cell 的格式从 %15s 放宽成 %s，exploit 用 47 个字符的 cell 字符串触发
